Name: Nadine's setting.
Author: viccallan
Description:
Setting sync for mod pack so my friend and I can easily sync settings.
the Mod Pack is unlisted but I couldn't get the settings in without making this mod.
The pack has 165 mods and this one changes the settings for 96 of them.
That's about it. Enjoy
